detail: SHIP-BLOCKER examples/platformer/src/engine/simulation.ts:151 clears jumpBuffered after every render tick even when accumulator < FIXED_DT and no simulation step ran. At 120/144 Hz, a jump captured on a zero-step frame is discarded before the next fixed step, making jump/coyote/buffer input intermittently fail and breaking traversal. Preserve the edge flag until at least one fixed step consumes it.
